calculation.description: A lagged five-day reversal signal whose strength increases when five-day VIX momentum is positive and is attenuated when VIX momentum is non-positive. VIX is aligned to asset dates using forward fill only after its own observed dates; asset return uses completed historical closes.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year: 2020 0.05663, 2021 0.05036, 2022 0.11852, 2023 0.02648, 2024 0.08227, 2025 0.01227, 2026 0.04120. Small 15-asset cross-section and approximately 50% signal coverage require conservative interpretation. The factor remains materially correlated with existing reversal artifacts and should be subject to deterministic library audit.
